title: Titanium Plating Rack Cross Bar
function: Cross-bar support bracket for plating rack frame
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this plating rack application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by cross-bar support bracket for plating rack frame and specific design requirements.
process: CNC machining CP Ti for plating rack geometry
TIG welding Ti filler with Class 6g gauge
Pickling and passivation with Class 6g gauge
Continuity test <1 mOhm with Class 6g gauge
surfaceTreatment: Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells — tailored for crossbar support bracket application
commonFailures: Uneven coating from current density variation - corrected by auxiliary anode 50mm from cathode — critical for crossbar support bracket performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Plating Rack Cross Bar suitable for Cross-bar support bracket for plating rack frame?
faq.a: Titanium Plating Rack Cross Bar uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address plating rack operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Plating Rack Cross Bar?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Plating Rack Cross Bar is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for crossbar support bracket requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Plating Rack Cross Bar require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. crossbar support bracket components require Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells — tailored for crossbar support bracket application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Plating Rack Cross Bar shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Plating Rack Cross Bar includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet crossbar support bracket specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Cross bar / Support bracket plating rack components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
